name: Flashcards
description: Generate fact-recall cues from your knowledge graph and review them with FSRS-6. Generation uses your configured model and may incur cost. Native only; no Anki integration.

zh.name: 闪卡
zh.description: 根据你的知识图谱生成事实回忆提示语，并用 FSRS-6 进行复习。生成会使用你配置的模型，可能产生费用。仅限内置功能，不集成 Anki。
